name: Chao hau
summary: Cháo hàu is oyster porridge on Đầm Lập An. Báo Quốc Tế calls it bổ dưỡng. Nhân Dân and VietnamPlus also name porridge for these oysters.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Báo Quốc Tế, 14 April 2026. Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024, and VietnamPlus, 9 February 2016, also name the porridge.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl on the lagoon. None of the three articles describes the rice or the garnish.
A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường Nguyễn Văn, along Đầm Lập An. No door is named.
